summary: Tested the Game Join Code feature on backend and frontend. Backend: 42/42 pytest pass (-n 0). I moved the 3 existing suites to the /api/games/{code} routes and added test_game_codes.py, which covers code format and uniqueness, case-insensitive lookup, the 404 'No game found with that code' detail, removal of the old /api/game and /api/actions routes, separation between games (players, turns, actions, and a player id from game A getting 404 in game B), custom actions used only in their own game's murders, and deleting one game leaving the other. Frontend (375x667, 3 separate browser contexts): the Welcome buttons, join validation (uppercase, 5 chars, disabled until 5, join-error for a wrong code), group isolation (C joined A and saw only A's players), the code surviving a reload (localStorage game_code), leave and rejoin, the actions editor saving only this game's actions, and a full day cycle (setup, day, roundtable, reveal, Day 2) with history and finale all work. One functional bug: 'End this game for everyone' does send the other phone back to Welcome in about 4s, but the welcome-game-gone message only flashes for an instant and is never visible to the user. No deprecated Expo packages or SafeAreaView misuse found.

minor.issue: GAME_LOCK is one global asyncio.Lock, so writes from every family group run one after another. Correct, but a per-code lock (dict of locks) would scale better.

ui_bugs.issue: The welcome-game-gone message is never readable. RCA: getGame returns {exists:false, gone:true}, Welcome renders and its useEffect calls setCode(null). setCode then calls queryClient.resetQueries(['game']), which refetches with currentCode=null and gets {exists:false} with no 'gone' flag, so the message unmounts within milliseconds. A MutationObserver confirmed it rendered and was gone well before the 3s check; no polling check ever saw it visible. Fix: keep a 'gone' flag outside the reset query (for example in GameCodeProvider state, or setQueryData(['game'], {exists:false, gone:true}) instead of resetQueries in this case) and clear it when the user starts or joins a game.

maxLength={5} cuts the raw text before onChangeText strips separators, so pasting a code with a dash or space loses characters: 'ab-c d12345' became 'ABC', and '4PN-UY' would become '4PNU'. Fix: remove maxLength (slice(0,5) already limits length) or set maxLength to about 12.
join-error stays on screen after the user edits the code. Call join.reset() inside onChangeText.

issues: The text says 'The 5-letter code', but codes contain digits too (for example 4PNUY, M7MEM). Change it to '5-character code'.
Buttons don't respond for about 1s while the FadeInDown entering animation runs. A tap straight after load did nothing, the same tap after about 1.8s navigated. Minor; consider a shorter delay.

action_items: HIGH: Make welcome-game-gone stay visible after a game is ended on another phone (see the RCA in ui_bugs). Today the phone goes back to Welcome correctly, but the message disappears instantly.
LOW: join.tsx: remove maxLength={5}, or raise it, so pasted codes containing '-' or spaces work.
LOW: join.tsx: clear join-error when the input changes (join.reset()).
LOW: Join copy: change '5-letter code' to '5-character code'.
OPTIONAL: Lock per game code instead of one global GAME_LOCK.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend: require_game/load_game normalise with strip().upper(); CODE_CHARS leaves out the easily confused 0/O/1/I/L; there is a unique index on code; and startup removes games without a code. All good.
DELETE /api/games/{code} returns 200 {exists:false} even for unknown codes. That is idempotent and fine for the 'end game' race between phones.
Welcome useEffect plus setCode(null) plus resetQueries is the root cause of the lost 'gone' message.
api.ts uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, which is correct for Expo.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_traitors_game.py (moved to /api/games/{code}; added G()/CUR helpers; setup_game deletes the previous test game)

success_rate.frontend: ~92% (all requested flows work; the welcome-game-gone message is not visible)

seed_data_creation: Test games used TEST_ prefixed players. All of them were deleted at the end; db.games is empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with -n 0. Helpers live in test_traitors_game.py: G(code) builds the game URL; setup_game() sets CUR['code']. ui_seed.py usage: python ui_seed.py create|setup|vote|delete <code>. In browser scripts, wait about 1.8s after welcome-screen appears before tapping (entering animation). Fetch from inside the page must use the public URL (localhost:3000 does not proxy /api). To set a phone's code: localStorage.setItem('game_code', JSON.stringify('CODE')) and reload.
rca_of_issue: welcome-game-gone: reproduced by putting a phone on the dashboard of game X, deleting X via the API, and watching with a MutationObserver. The message rendered (4 observer hits) but was not visible at +3s. Welcome's effect calls setCode(null), and its resetQueries refetch returns {exists:false} without gone=true.
